exposure: Early warning scoring system for neonatal pneumonia based on information technology (integrated into the hospital's electronic health record system)
outcome: Time to symptom resolution (cough, dyspnea, pulmonary rales, return to normal temperature, relief of respiratory distress)
Blood gas analysis indicators (Oxygen saturation (SpO2), partial pressure of arterial oxygen (PaO2), arterial oxygen saturation (SaO2), partial pressure of arterial carbon dioxide (PaCO2))
cohort: 140 neonates diagnosed with pneumonia admitted to a hospital between July 2020 and December 2023.
finding: The application of an early warning scoring system for neonatal pneumonia significantly shortened the time to symptom resolution, improved respiratory status, normalized blood gas indices, and reduced the incidence of complications.
